operations:
[
 {
  "data_source": "Site DB",
  "raw_sql": "SELECT
    company,
    fiscal_year,
    SUM(total_income)                      AS total_income,
    SUM(total_expense)                     AS total_expense,
    SUM(total_income) - SUM(total_expense) AS profit

FROM (

    /* ── SALES REGISTER  →  income ─────────────────────────────── */
    SELECT
        si.company,
        fy.year                             AS fiscal_year,
        si.posting_date,
        CASE
            WHEN si.is_internal_customer = 1 THEN 'NO'
            ELSE 'YES'
        END                                 AS is_internal,
        CASE
            WHEN si.is_internal_customer = 1
             AND si.company = si.represents_company
            THEN 0
            ELSE COALESCE(income.total_income, si.base_net_total)
        END                                 AS total_income,
        0                                   AS total_expense

    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si

    LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` c
        ON c.name = si.customer

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT fy.year, fy.year_start_date, fy.year_end_date, fyc.company
        FROM `tabFiscal Year` fy
        INNER JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` fyc
            ON fyc.parent = fy.name
        WHERE fy.disabled = 0
    ) fy
        ON  fy.company       = si.company
        AND si.posting_date >= fy.year_start_date
        AND si.posting_date <= fy.year_end_date

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT x.parent, SUM(x.amount) AS total_income
        FROM (
            SELECT parent, income_account, SUM(base_net_amount) AS amount
            FROM `tabSales Invoice Item`
            WHERE docstatus = 1
            GROUP BY parent, income_account

            UNION ALL

            SELECT stc.parent, stc.account_head,
                   SUM(stc.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
            FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` stc
            INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
                ON  sii.parent         = stc.parent
                AND sii.income_account = stc.account_head
            WHERE stc.parenttype = 'Sales Invoice'
            GROUP BY stc.parent, stc.account_head
        ) x
        GROUP BY x.parent
    ) income
        ON income.parent = si.name

    WHERE si.docstatus = 1

    /* ── PURCHASE REGISTER  →  expense ─────────────────────────── */
    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        pi.company,
        fy.year                             AS fiscal_year,
        pi.posting_date,
        CASE
            WHEN pi.is_internal_supplier = 1 THEN 'NO'
            ELSE 'YES'
        END                                 AS is_internal,
        0                                   AS total_income,
        CASE
            WHEN pi.is_internal_supplier = 1
             AND pi.company = pi.represents_company
            THEN pi.base_net_total
            ELSE COALESCE(expense.total_expense, pi.base_net_total)
        END                                 AS total_expense

    FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` pi

    LEFT JOIN `tabSupplier` s
        ON s.name = pi.supplier

    LEFT JOIN `tabFiscal Year` fy
        ON pi.posting_date BETWEEN fy.year_start_date AND fy.year_end_date
    LEFT JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` fyc
        ON  fyc.parent  = fy.name
        AND fyc.company = pi.company

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT x.parent, SUM(x.amount) AS total_expense
        FROM (
            SELECT parent, expense_account, SUM(base_net_amount) AS amount
            FROM `tabPurchase Invoice Item`
            WHERE docstatus = 1
            GROUP BY parent, expense_account

            UNION ALL

            SELECT ptc.parent, ptc.account_head,
                   SUM(
                       CASE ptc.add_deduct_tax
                           WHEN 'Add' THEN  ptc.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount
                           ELSE            -ptc.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount
                       END
                   )
            FROM `tabPurchase Taxes and Charges` ptc
            WHERE ptc.category IN ('Total', 'Valuation and Total')
              AND ptc.account_head IN (
                    SELECT DISTINCT expense_account
                    FROM `tabPurchase Invoice Item`
                    WHERE expense_account IS NOT NULL
              )
            GROUP BY ptc.parent, ptc.account_head
        ) x
        GROUP BY x.parent
    ) expense
        ON expense.parent = pi.name

    WHERE pi.docstatus = 1

) combined

GROUP BY
    company

ORDER BY
    company,
    fiscal_year
",
  "type": "sql"
 }
]
title: Revenue

operations:
[
 {

  "raw_sql": "SELECT
    block.section,

    block.project,
    block.remarks,
    block.fiscal_year,
    block.is_opening,
    block.account_period_total,
    block.sort_order,
    block.block_order,
    block.company,
    block.fiscal_year_label
FROM (

    /* ================= INCOME ================= */
    SELECT
        'Income' AS section,
        ge.name  AS gl_entry_name,
        ge.posting_date,
        ge.voucher_type,
        ge.voucher_no,
        ge.against_voucher_type,
        ge.against_voucher,
        ge.party_type,
        ge.party,
        ge.against,
        ge.account,

        CASE
            WHEN a.account_number IS NOT NULL AND a.account_number != ''
            THEN CONCAT(a.account_number, ' - ', a.account_name)
            ELSE a.account_name
        END AS account_name,

        a.parent_account,
        a.account_type,
        a.include_in_gross,

        ROUND(ge.credit - ge.debit, 3) AS amount,
        ROUND(ge.debit,  3)            AS debit,
        ROUND(ge.credit, 3)            AS credit,

        ge.account_currency,
        ge.cost_center,
        ge.project,
        ge.remarks,
        ge.fiscal_year,
        ge.is_opening,

        totals.total_amount            AS account_period_total,

        a.lft  AS sort_order,
        1      AS block_order,
        ge.company,
        fy_range.fiscal_year_label

    FROM `tabGL Entry` ge

    INNER JOIN `tabAccount` a
        ON  a.name     = ge.account
        AND a.company  = ge.company
        AND a.is_group = 0

    INNER JOIN `tabAccount` ir
        ON  ir.company                   = ge.company
        AND ir.root_type                 = 'Income'
        AND IFNULL(ir.parent_account,'') = ''
        AND a.lft >= ir.lft
        AND a.rgt <= ir.rgt

    /* ── Current FY + Previous FY date ranges ── */
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            fyc.company,
            fy.year_start_date  AS effective_from,
            fy.year_end_date    AS effective_to,
            fy.name             AS fiscal_year_label
        FROM `tabFiscal Year` fy
        INNER JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` fyc
            ON fyc.parent = fy.name
        WHERE fy.disabled      = 0
          AND fy.is_short_year = 0
          AND CURDATE() BETWEEN fy.year_start_date AND fy.year_end_date

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            fyc.company,
            fy.year_start_date,
            fy.year_end_date,
            fy.name
        FROM `tabFiscal Year` fy
        INNER JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` fyc
            ON fyc.parent = fy.name
        WHERE fy.disabled      = 0
          AND fy.is_short_year = 0
          AND fy.year_end_date = (
              SELECT DATE_SUB(curr.year_start_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
              FROM `tabFiscal Year` curr
              INNER JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` curr_fyc
                  ON curr_fyc.parent = curr.name
              WHERE curr.disabled      = 0
                AND curr.is_short_year = 0
                AND CURDATE() BETWEEN curr.year_start_date AND curr.year_end_date
                AND curr_fyc.company   = fyc.company
              LIMIT 1
          )
    ) fy_range
        ON  fy_range.company       = ge.company
        AND ge.posting_date       >= fy_range.effective_from
        AND ge.posting_date       <= fy_range.effective_to

    /* ── Period totals per account per fiscal year ── */
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            gi.account,
            gi.company,
            fy_t.fiscal_year_label,
            ROUND(SUM(gi.credit - gi.debit), 3) AS total_amount
        FROM `tabGL Entry` gi
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT
                fyc.company,
                fy.year_start_date  AS effective_from,
                fy.year_end_date    AS effective_to,
                fy.name             AS fiscal_year_label
            FROM `tabFiscal Year` fy
            INNER JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` fyc ON fyc.parent = fy.name
            WHERE fy.disabled = 0 AND fy.is_short_year = 0
              AND CURDATE() BETWEEN fy.year_start_date AND fy.year_end_date

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                fyc.company,
                fy.year_start_date,
                fy.year_end_date,
                fy.name
            FROM `tabFiscal Year` fy
            INNER JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` fyc ON fyc.parent = fy.name
            WHERE fy.disabled = 0 AND fy.is_short_year = 0
              AND fy.year_end_date = (
                  SELECT DATE_SUB(curr.year_start_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
                  FROM `tabFiscal Year` curr
                  INNER JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` curr_fyc ON curr_fyc.parent = curr.name
                  WHERE curr.disabled = 0 AND curr.is_short_year = 0
                    AND CURDATE() BETWEEN curr.year_start_date AND curr.year_end_date
                    AND curr_fyc.company = fyc.company
                  LIMIT 1
              )
        ) fy_t
            ON  fy_t.company      = gi.company
            AND gi.posting_date  >= fy_t.effective_from
            AND gi.posting_date  <= fy_t.effective_to
        WHERE gi.is_cancelled  = 0
          AND gi.voucher_type != 'Period Closing Voucher'
        GROUP BY gi.company, gi.account, fy_t.fiscal_year_label
    ) totals
        ON  totals.account           = ge.account
        AND totals.company           = ge.company
        AND totals.fiscal_year_label = fy_range.fiscal_year_label

    WHERE ge.is_cancelled  = 0
      AND ge.voucher_type != 'Period Closing Voucher'
      AND (ge.finance_book = '' OR ge.finance_book IS NULL)


    UNION ALL


    /* ================= EXPENSE ================= */
    SELECT
        'Expense' AS section,
        ge.name   AS gl_entry_name,
        ge.posting_date,
        ge.voucher_type,
        ge.voucher_no,
        ge.against_voucher_type,
        ge.against_voucher,
        ge.party_type,
        ge.party,
        ge.against,
        ge.account,

        CASE
            WHEN a.account_number IS NOT NULL AND a.account_number != ''

        totals.total_amount            AS account_period_total,

        a.lft  AS sort_order,
        2      AS block_order,
        ge.company,
        fy_range.fiscal_year_label

    FROM `tabGL Entry` ge

    INNER JOIN `tabAccount` a

        AND er.root_type                 = 'Expense'
        AND IFNULL(er.parent_account,'') = ''
        AND a.lft >= er.lft
        AND a.rgt <= er.rgt

    INNER JOIN (

            fyc.company,

        FROM `tabFiscal Year` fy
        INNER JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` fyc

        WHERE fy.disabled      = 0

name: 78sje4pftg
operations:
[
 {
  "data_source": "Site DB",
  "raw_sql": "SELECT
    company,
    fiscal_year,
    posting_date,
    cost_center,
    is_internal,

    SUM(total_income)                      AS total_income,
    SUM(total_expense)                     AS total_expense,
    SUM(total_income) - SUM(total_expense) AS profit

FROM (

    /* ── SALES (Income) ─────────────────────────────── */
    SELECT
        si.company,
        fy.name AS fiscal_year,
        si.posting_date,
        sii.cost_center,

        /* ✅ Customer logic */
        CASE
            WHEN c.is_internal_customer = 1 THEN 'NO'
            ELSE 'YES'
        END AS is_internal,

        /* ✅ Income */
        CASE
            WHEN c.is_internal_customer = 1
             AND si.company = si.represents_company
            THEN 0
            ELSE COALESCE(income.total_income, si.base_net_total)
        END AS total_income,

        0 AS total_expense

    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si

    INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
        ON sii.parent = si.name

    LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` c
        ON c.name = si.customer

    /* ✅ Correct Fiscal Year join */
    LEFT JOIN `tabFiscal Year` fy
        ON si.posting_date BETWEEN fy.year_start_date AND fy.year_end_date

    LEFT JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` fyc
        ON fyc.parent = fy.name
        AND fyc.company = si.company

    /* Income calculation */
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT x.parent, SUM(x.amount) AS total_income
        FROM (
            SELECT parent, SUM(base_net_amount) AS amount
            FROM `tabSales Invoice Item`
            GROUP BY parent

            UNION ALL

            SELECT stc.parent,
                   SUM(stc.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount)
            FROM `tabSales Taxes and Charges` stc
            GROUP BY stc.parent
        ) x
        GROUP BY x.parent
    ) income
        ON income.parent = si.name

    WHERE si.docstatus = 1
      AND si.is_return = 0
      AND si.is_opening = "NO"


    UNION ALL


    /* ── PURCHASE (Expense) ─────────────────────────── */
    SELECT
        pi.company,
        fy.name AS fiscal_year,
        pi.posting_date,
        pii.cost_center,

        /* ✅ Supplier logic */
        CASE
            WHEN pi.is_internal_supplier = 1 THEN 'NO'
            ELSE 'YES'
        END AS is_internal,

        0 AS total_income,

        /* ✅ Expense */
        CASE
            WHEN pi.is_internal_supplier = 1
             AND pi.company = pi.represents_company
            THEN pi.base_net_total
            ELSE COALESCE(expense.total_expense, pi.base_net_total)
        END AS total_expense

    FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` pi

    INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii
        ON pii.parent = pi.name

    LEFT JOIN `tabSupplier` s
        ON s.name = pi.supplier

    /* ✅ Correct Fiscal Year join */
    LEFT JOIN `tabFiscal Year` fy
        ON pi.posting_date BETWEEN fy.year_start_date AND fy.year_end_date

    LEFT JOIN `tabFiscal Year Company` fyc
        ON fyc.parent = fy.name
        AND fyc.company = pi.company

    /* Expense calculation */
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT x.parent, SUM(x.amount) AS total_expense
        FROM (
            SELECT parent, SUM(base_net_amount) AS amount
            FROM `tabPurchase Invoice Item`
            GROUP BY parent

            UNION ALL

            SELECT ptc.parent,
                   SUM(
                       CASE ptc.add_deduct_tax
                           WHEN 'Add' THEN ptc.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount
                           ELSE -ptc.base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount
                       END
                   )
            FROM `tabPurchase Taxes and Charges` ptc
            GROUP BY ptc.parent
        ) x
        GROUP BY x.parent
    ) expense
        ON expense.parent = pi.name

    WHERE pi.docstatus = 1

) combined

GROUP BY
    company,
    fiscal_year,
    posting_date,
    cost_center,
    is_internal

ORDER BY
    company,
    fiscal_year,
    posting_date DESC,
    cost_center,
    is_internal;",
  "type": "sql"
 }
]

name: 27ujoorp2b
operations:
[
 {
  "data_source": "Site DB",
  "raw_sql": "SELECT
    gle.company,
    gle.fiscal_year,
    gle.name,
    gle.posting_date,
    gle.voucher_type,
    gle.voucher_no,
    gle.party_type,
    CASE 
    
        /* ================= SALES INVOICE ================= */
        WHEN gle.voucher_type = 'Sales Invoice' THEN
            (
                SELECT c.customer_name
                FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
                JOIN `tabCustomer` c ON c.name = si.customer
                WHERE si.name = gle.voucher_no
                LIMIT 1
            )
    
        /* ================= PURCHASE INVOICE ================= */
        WHEN gle.voucher_type = 'Purchase Invoice' THEN
            (
                SELECT s.supplier_name
                FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
                JOIN `tabSupplier` s ON s.name = pi.supplier
                WHERE pi.name = gle.voucher_no
                LIMIT 1
            )
    
        /* ================= PAYMENT ENTRY ================= */
        WHEN gle.voucher_type = 'Payment Entry' THEN
            (
                SELECT 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN pe.party_type = 'Customer' THEN c.customer_name
                        WHEN pe.party_type = 'Supplier' THEN s.supplier_name
                        WHEN pe.party_type = 'Employee' THEN e.employee_name
                        ELSE pe.party
                    END
                FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
                LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` c 
                    ON c.name = pe.party 
                    AND pe.party_type = 'Customer'
                LEFT JOIN `tabSupplier` s 
                    ON s.name = pe.party 
                    AND pe.party_type = 'Supplier'
                LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e 
                    ON e.name = pe.party 
                    AND pe.party_type = 'Employee'
                WHERE pe.name = gle.voucher_no
                LIMIT 1
            )
    
        /* ================= JOURNAL ENTRY ================= */
        WHEN gle.voucher_type = 'Journal Entry' THEN
            (
                SELECT 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN jea.party_type = 'Customer' THEN c.customer_name
                        WHEN jea.party_type = 'Supplier' THEN s.supplier_name
                        WHEN jea.party_type = 'Employee' THEN e.employee_name
                        ELSE jea.party
                    END
                FROM `tabJournal Entry Account` jea
                LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` c 
                    ON c.name = jea.party 
                    AND jea.party_type = 'Customer'
                LEFT JOIN `tabSupplier` s 
                    ON s.name = jea.party 
                    AND jea.party_type = 'Supplier'
                LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e 
                    ON e.name = jea.party 
                    AND jea.party_type = 'Employee'
                WHERE jea.parent = gle.voucher_no
                AND jea.party IS NOT NULL
                LIMIT 1
            )
    
        /* ================= FALLBACK ================= */
        ELSE gle.party
    
    END AS party_name,

    /* ================= COST CENTER ================= */

    COALESCE(
        gle.cost_center,

        /* Sales Invoice */
        (SELECT si.cost_center
         FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
         WHERE si.name = gle.voucher_no
         LIMIT 1),

        /* Purchase Invoice */
        (SELECT pi.cost_center
         FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
         WHERE pi.name = gle.voucher_no
         LIMIT 1),

        /* Payment Entry */
        (SELECT pe.cost_center
         FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
         WHERE pe.name = gle.voucher_no
         LIMIT 1),

        /* Journal Entry */
        (SELECT jea.cost_center
         FROM `tabJournal Entry Account` jea
         WHERE jea.parent = gle.voucher_no
         AND jea.cost_center IS NOT NULL
         LIMIT 1)

    ) AS cost_center,


    ROUND(SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN a.root_type = 'Income'
            THEN gle.credit - gle.debit
            ELSE 0
        END
    ),2) AS total_income,

    ROUND(SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN a.root_type = 'Expense'
            THEN gle.debit - gle.credit
            ELSE 0
        END
    ),2) AS total_expense,

    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.root_type = 'Income'
                 THEN gle.credit - gle.debit ELSE 0 END)
        -
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.root_type = 'Expense'
                 THEN gle.debit - gle.credit ELSE 0 END)
    ,2) AS profit,


    /* ================= INTERNAL CUSTOMER ================= */

    CASE gle.voucher_type

        WHEN 'Sales Invoice' THEN
            CASE
                WHEN (
                    SELECT c.is_internal_customer
                    FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
                    JOIN `tabCustomer` c ON c.name = si.customer
                    WHERE si.name = gle.voucher_no
                    LIMIT 1
                ) = 1 THEN 'NO'
                ELSE 'YES'
            END

        WHEN 'Purchase Invoice' THEN
            CASE
                WHEN (
                    SELECT s.is_internal_supplier
                    FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
                    JOIN `tabSupplier` s ON s.name = pi.supplier
                    WHERE pi.name = gle.voucher_no
                    LIMIT 1
                ) = 1 THEN 'NO'
                ELSE 'YES'
            END

        WHEN 'Payment Entry' THEN
            CASE
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM `tabPayment Entry` pe
                    LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` c
                        ON c.name = pe.party
                        AND pe.party_type='Customer'
                    LEFT JOIN `tabSupplier` s
                        ON s.name = pe.party
                        AND pe.party_type='Supplier'
                    WHERE pe.name = gle.voucher_no
                    AND (c.is_internal_customer=1
                         OR s.is_internal_supplier=1)
                )
                THEN 'NO'
                ELSE 'YES'
            END

        WHEN 'Journal Entry' THEN
            CASE
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM `tabJournal Entry Account` jea
                    LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` c
                        ON c.name = jea.party
                        AND jea.party_type='Customer'
                    LEFT JOIN `tabSupplier` s
                        ON s.name = jea.party
                        AND jea.party_type='Supplier'
                    WHERE jea.parent = gle.voucher_no
                    AND (c.is_internal_customer=1
                         OR s.is_internal_supplier=1)
                )
                THEN 'NO'
                ELSE 'YES'
            END

        ELSE 'YES'
    END AS internal_customer

FROM `tabGL Entry` gle
INNER JOIN `tabAccount` a
    ON  a.name = gle.account
    AND a.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense')

WHERE
    gle.is_cancelled = 0
    AND gle.is_opening = 'No'
    AND gle.voucher_type != 'Period Closing Voucher'

GROUP BY
    gle.name,
    gle.posting_date,
    gle.company,
    gle.fiscal_year,
    gle.voucher_type,
    gle.voucher_no,
    gle.party_type,
    cost_center

ORDER BY
    gle.posting_date,
    gle.name;",
  "type": "sql"
 }
